prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity portrait mobile web app composition, 393x852 viewport
Primary request: LifeGoods Khmer-first packaged-food barcode home screen, camera-first composition, visual option B
Input images: the two user screenshots are structural references only; borrow their direct scan-first hierarchy and high legibility, never their brands, scores, verdicts, colors, or content
Structure: compact sticky white header with Phosphor-style palm tree mark plus LifeGoods on the left and one ‘English’ language button on the right; beneath it a tall pale-neutral scan window with a centered charcoal barcode frame, subtle corner geometry, Camera icon, and visible bilingual unavailable status, but no photographic background; the barcode form is a single strong horizontal control directly attached to the bottom of the scan window, with a large numeric input and green trailing submit segment; concise help text follows; fixed bottom nav with Home active and Learn, History, Allergies inactive
Style/medium: production-grade mobile web utility, precise editorial spacing, flat tonal separation, crisp 1px lines, warm humanist Khmer-capable sans, compact but readable
Color palette: neutral white and very pale cool green surfaces, charcoal ink, restrained deep green for action and active navigation only
Text (verbatim where possible): ‘LifeGoods’, ‘English’, ‘ពិនិត្យបាកូដលើកញ្ចប់’, ‘កាមេរ៉ាមិនទាន់អាចប្រើបាន’, ‘លេខបាកូដ’, ‘ពិនិត្យ’, ‘Home’, ‘Learn’, ‘History’, ‘Allergies’
Constraints: camera placeholder must be clearly non-interactive; manual barcode field visible within the first viewport; bottom nav labels never hidden; no scores or verdicts
Avoid: Open Food Facts logo, product imagery, photography, health claims, green reassurance, gradients, glass, oversized pills, oversized rounded cards, tile grid, promotional hero, watermark
selectionReason: Best product clarity: the unavailable camera state is explicit, manual entry stays in the first viewport, and restrained green is reserved for action and selection.
